description: What a US state's gun laws say, the way the GunPartPicker gun law pages put it: clear, caution or restricted, with the detail, the state's own notes and the statute. Give a state alone for every topic at a glance, or a state and a topic for the full answer. Topics: overview (Overall), assault-weapons (Assault weapons), magazines (Magazines), suppressors (Suppressors), sbr (SBRs), frt (FRTs), binary-triggers (Binary triggers), concealed-carry (Carry), permit-to-purchase (Permit to buy), age (Minimum age), red-flag (Red flag).
